entities.summary: The Jardin Exotique de Monaco is a botanical garden located on a cliffside in Monaco. The garden, which first opened in 1931, primarily features exotic succulent plants. The garden is the home to the Museum of Prehistoric Anthropology, whose exhibits include pre-historic artifacts that were excavated from the garden's grotto. Jardin Exotique de Monaco is a botanical garden in Europe, established in 1931. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
